The approximation complex was initially developed by Herzog, Simis and
Vasconcelos in a sequence of papers [HSV83b], [HSV82], and [HSV83a] to
study syzygies in conormal modules. It was first used in elimination theory

others applied this tool to study subjects such as regularity and Rees algebra.
